title: Summers Hot NFT Sales - COPI Cafe #17
description:
0In this latest episode of COPICafe, Cornucopias CEOs Rob Greig and Josh Jones discuss the latest events from within the Cornucopias metaverse game. Rob and Josh discuss the Custom Dome Sale, Upcoming Hard Fork and Roadmap. Later in the episode they are joined by Jim, our Technical Director and discuss his background and role at Cornucopias. Stay until the end for some game asset leaks. Listen to the corn-brains behind it all as they discuss Cornucopias' latest developments. 

Crack open your favorite beverage, enjoy this information-packed chat in the casual, comfy, corntastic episode of COPICafe!

#Metaverse #Cardano #CryptoCurrency #Blockchain #NFT #MetaverseGame #IOHK 

01:06 - Beverage Choices
03:50 - Vasil Hard Fork
05:48 - Custom Dome Sale Before of Hard Fork
07:19 - Chainport Bridge
09:07 - Improvements to NFT Marketplace
09:36 - NFT2Tree Series 3
11:27 - Land Staking Update
14:42 - Roadmap Changes
18:09 - Special Guest - Jim, Cornucopias Technical Director
19:26 - Jim's Background
21:38 - Jim's Role at Cornucopias
22:40 - Character Creator
23:43 - In-Game Need System
26:47 - Biggest Challenge
27:14 - Why are Pets & Mounts Delayed
28:24 - What is a Mesh?
29:25 - Breeding Animals
30:05 - Technical Director Responsibilities
33:40 - Manchester Highlights
36:41 - Last Weeks Leak Reveal
39:44 - LEAK
